# semaphore_ex_app (Resource)

Manages a custom task application. The executable path and arguments describe the command installed on runners; configuring an app does not execute it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_app" "custom" {
  id       = "custom_tool"
  title    = "Custom tool"
  path     = "/usr/local/bin/custom-tool"
  args     = ["--verbose"]
  active   = true
  priority = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Stable custom application identifier. Use letters, digits and underscores, as required by the server option keys.
- `path` (String) Executable path on the runner. String length must be at least 1.
- `title` (String) Display title. String length must be at least 1.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Makes the app available for task templates. Value defaults to `true`.
- `args` (List of String) Command arguments supplied to the application.
- `color` (String) Light-theme icon color. Value defaults to ``.
- `dark_color` (String) Dark-theme icon color. Value defaults to ``.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier. Value defaults to ``.
- `priority` (Number) Display ordering priority. Value defaults to `0`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_app.custom custom_tool
```
